items.title: 1. Chest Pain: what the heart research adds to your angina story
items.your_version: So far, the heart research on DMSO has only been in animals and lab dishes, and only as a prophylactic (preventative treatment). When they gave it to rats for three days before a heart attack, those rats lost about three quarters less heart muscle than the rats who didn't get DMSO. Most heart attacks come from a clot blocking an artery, so it's a good sign that DMSO also slowed clotting, in mice and in human platelets (the blood cells that start clots) in a dish.
